scientific.integrity: The source model equations, feasible region, steady-state segment, Theorems 4.9 and 4.12, the numerical conjecture in Section 5.2 and the discussion were inspected in official open full text. Comparisons include the original epidemiological simulation model and prior set-based SIR results. All nonstandard analytic steps are proved explicitly and a standalone reproducible numerical checker corroborates a worked case. No independent audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific.limitations: The closure of attainable limits and minimal closed attraction are proved only for strictly infected initial conditions with positive susceptible total. This is not global attraction on the entire simplex. Endpoints of the closed segment are closure points; the small-seed response is pointwise away from the invasion boundary.

title: Exact endpoint reachability and weak-seed response in a reversible-confinement epidemic model
